title: A NEW FRAMEWORK FOR CYBERSECURITY REFUSALS IN AI AGENTS
reasoning: The paper defines and benchmarks a 'Tripartite Refusal Taxonomy' to establish normative boundaries for AI agents in cybersecurity. It evaluates when agents should or should not refuse tasks based on potential for catastrophic harm and the legitimacy of the intent, which is a core component of AI safety ethics and normative policy for dual-use technologies.
